rationale: The feature (OTable selection-cell PADDING click) is a reusable-component interaction, not a model-pricing business journey. The only nearby spec, model-pricing.spec.js, is a 1070-line CRUD suite whose 'Bulk Actions' test clicks the CHECKBOX (button[role=checkbox] via checkRowByName) — it never exercises the select-cell padding, which is the actual behavior under test. The run-context assigns a dedicated spec path (otableSelectCell.spec.js), and the feature is clearly its own area, so a new GeneralTests spec keeps 'one spec = one feature area' without bloating model-pricing.spec.js. No existing spec in the repo touches td[data-test=o2-table-select-cell] or th[data-test=o2-table-th-select] (verified: only the OTable source + feature doc reference them).
